name: poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1

function.text: PARP1 encodes poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1 ADP-ribosyltransferase 1) [Cleaved into: Poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1, processed C-terminus; Poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1, processed N-terminus]. Annotated molecular activities include transcription regulator activator activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.
